hook: Most financial scams rely on one simple trick

caption:
Protect your assets by verifying the identity of anyone offering financial services. Impersonators often use closed social media groups to build false trust. Always check official regulatory databases before engaging with someone claiming to be a financial professional. Context: SEBI. Have you ever double-checked a professional's credentials before taking advice? Save this for later and share it with someone who needs it. #FinancialHealth #MoneyTips #ConsumerProtection #FinancialLiteracy #RXT #SmartInvesting #MoneyManagement
